Message.Name: Start of Spin Message
Message.Description: This message appears on all quote channels and indicates the beginning of a spin message cycle.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: SpinType
Field.Description: Spin type

Field.Name: SpinStartTimeMilli
Field.Description: Milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Field.Name: SpinLastSeqNum
Field.Description: Last sequence number applied to this spin.

Message.Name: End of Spin Message
Message.Description: This message appears on all quote channels and indicates the end of a spin message cycle.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: SpinType
Field.Description: Spin type

Field.Name: SpinMsgCt
Field.Description: Total number of messages in the spin.

Field.Name: SpinEndTimeMilli
Field.Description: Milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Field.Name: SpinLastSeqNum
Field.Description: Last sequence number applied to this spin.

Message.Name: Market Open Message
Message.Description: This message is sent out at 6 AM on all channels. The message can also be sent mid-day if a technical outage caused a temporary closure of the market.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: MarketOpen
Field.Description: Market open time in milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Field.Name: MarketClose
Field.Description: Anticipated market close time in milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Message.Name: Market Close Message
Message.Description: This message is sent out at 5 PM on all channels. The message can also be sent mid-day if a technical outage causes a temporary closure of the market.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: MarketCloseTimeMilli
Field.Description: Market close time in milliseconds since UTC epoch midnight.

Field.Name: MarketMsgCt
Field.Description: Total day message count.

Message.Name: Security Message
Message.Description: The Security Message is included in all quote channels and provides basic security attribute information.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker symbol. Fixed income symbols may not have a symbol. For these securities, the SecurityID or CUSIP (Reference Data Security Message) must be used as an identifier.

Field.Name: LastUpdateMilli
Field.Description: Milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Field.Name: SecurityAction
Field.Description: Security action indicator.

Field.Name: AssetClass
Field.Description: Asset class of the security.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Unique security ID issued by OTC Markets.

Field.Name: SecurityFlags
Field.Description: Security flags. See SecurityFlags definition.

Field.Name: Tier
Field.Description: Market tier assigned by OTC Markets Group.

Field.Name: ReportingStatus
Field.Description: Reporting status of the issuer.

Field.Name: SecurityStatus
Field.Description: Current security status.

Message.Name: Quote Message
Message.Description: This message is sent on the Quote Book channel and the Quote Book with Global OTC data channel.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: QuoteID
Field.Description: Unique Quote ID.

Field.Name: QuoteAction
Field.Description: Quote action indicator.

Field.Name: QuoteFlags
Field.Description: Quote flags. See QuoteFlags definition.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: OTC Markets security ID.

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Market Participant ID owning the quote (always 4 characters).

Field.Name: AskPrice
Field.Description: Ask price, 6 decimal places assumed.

Field.Name: AskSize
Field.Description: Number of shares on the ask.

Field.Name: AskQAP
Field.Description: Specifies the access fee or rebate for the offer. Positive values (1 to 30) indicate a rebate, negative values (-1 to -30) indicate an access fee, and 0 indicates no rebate or access fee.

Field.Name: AskTimeMilli
Field.Description: Milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Field.Name: BidPrice
Field.Description: Bid price, 6 decimal places assumed.

Field.Name: BidSize
Field.Description: Number of shares on the bid.

Field.Name: BidQAP
Field.Description: Specifies the access fee or rebate for the bid. Positive values (1 to 30) indicate a rebate, negative values (-1 to -30) indicate an access fee, and 0 indicates no rebate or access fee.

Field.Name: BidTimeMilli
Field.Description: Milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Field.Name: QuoteReferenceID
Field.Description: Numeric value (0 to 64,999) assigned by the quote owner for correlation purposes (FIX Tag 9670).

Field.Name: ExtendedQuoteFlags
Field.Description: Extended quote flags. See ExtendedQuoteFlags definition.

Message.Name: Quote Update Message
Message.Description: Quote update information for the Quote Book channel and the Quote Book with Global OTC data channel.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: QuoteID
Field.Description: Quote ID referring back to the original quote reference.

Field.Name: QuoteFlags
Field.Description: Quote flags. See QuoteFlags definition.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price with 6 decimal places assumed.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of shares.

Field.Name: QAP
Field.Description: Specifies the access fee or rebate for the bid/offer. Positive values (1 to 30) indicate a rebate, negative values (-1 to -30) indicate an access fee, and 0 indicates no rebate or access fee.

Field.Name: QuoteTimeMilli
Field.Description: Milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Field.Name: QuoteReferenceID
Field.Description: Numeric value (0 to 64,999) assigned by the quote owner for correlation purposes (FIX Tag 9670).

Field.Name: ExtendedQuoteFlags
Field.Description: Extended quote flags. See ExtendedQuoteFlags definition.

Field.Name: ProprietaryQuoteEligible
Field.Description: Security is eligible for proprietary quoting under SEC Rule 15c-211.

Field.Name: CaveatEmptorWarning
Field.Description: Indicates whether a Caveat Emptor warning has been applied.

Field.Name: QualifiedInstitutionalBuyersOnly
Field.Description: Indicates if the security is restricted to Qualified Institutional Buyers.

Field.Name: UnsolicitedOnly
Field.Description: Indicates if the security may only be quoted unsolicited.

Field.Name: BBQuoted
Field.Description: Indicates if the security is quoted on the OTC Bulletin Board.

Field.Name: OTCLinkECNEligible
Field.Description: OTC Link ECN eligible.

Field.Name: OTCLinkMessagingDisabled
Field.Description: OTC Link Messaging Disabled.

Field.Name: SaturationEligible
Field.Description: Indicates if a security is eligible to have their quotes saturated.

Field.Name: UpdateSide
Field.Description: Ask or Bid

Field.Name: State
Field.Description: Open or Closed

Field.Name: AskUnsolicited
Field.Description: Ask Unsolicited

Field.Name: AskPriced
Field.Description: Ask Priced

Field.Name: AskBidWanted
Field.Description: Ask Bid Wanted

Field.Name: BidUnsolicited
Field.Description: Bid Unsolicited

Field.Name: BidPriced
Field.Description: Bid Priced

Field.Name: BidAskWanted
Field.Description: Bid Ask Wanted

Field.Name: QuoteSaturated
Field.Description: Determines whether the quote should be considered for the inside price.

Field.Name: BidAutoEx
Field.Description: If the AutoEx flag is set for the bid side, responses to OTC Link trade messages are immediate.

Field.Name: OfferAutoEx
Field.Description: If the AutoEx flag is set for the offer side, responses to OTC Link trade messages are immediate.

Field.Name: NMSConditionalQuote
Field.Description: The displayed quote size is a round lot at least two times greater than the minimum round lot size and cannot be partially filled.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved Extended Quote Flag Bits
